item.description: Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or PFAS, are a class of long-lasting chemicals that have been linked to harmful human health effects, like increased risk of cancer, reduced ability to fight infections and reproductive effects, according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency.
